terra.problem: The text says troops were stationed in every fortified city, not that every gate was covered or that Jehoshaphat wanted every gate covered.
The passage says David's earlier ways, not necessarily how he first walked. It also does not say Jehoshaphat was looking back at them.
Calling Israel the kingdom to the north adds a Bible fact from outside this passage without a reference.

The passage says the team went to teach, but it does not say they carried no swords.
Taking the Book with them does not establish that they never taught from memory.

The passage says some Philistines brought gifts and silver, not the Philistines without that qualification.
The passage says Jehoshaphat kept vast supplies in the cities of Judah; it does not specifically say they were in the store cities.
